subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Jaguar engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the Ford Duratorq across its XF X250 application.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The Ford Duratorq appears in a single Jaguar application — the XF 2.2D (X250, 2008–2015).

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets and seals as standard on every rebuild, with timing chain components inspected and replaced where required.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: EGR valve clogging is common on higher-mileage examples, injector seal problems are well-documented, and DPF clogging can occur with short-trip or urban use. We inspect all of these areas during every rebuild.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page — they'll be added once a documented set of completed Ford Duratorq rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.

typical.title: JAGUAR FORD DURATORQ REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine — illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.
typical.body: The Ford Duratorq's timing chain system is inspected thoroughly during every rebuild. EGR valve and cooler inspection is standard, as is DPF component inspection. Turbocharger and high-pressure fuel pump condition are both measured and assessed. On higher-mileage examples, injector seal condition is a particular focus.

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets and seals, timing chain components where required, EGR system inspection, DPF inspection, injector seal inspection

cards.title: INSPECTION & STRIP-DOWN
cards.body: Careful inspection of the crankshaft, cylinder head, and timing chain components during strip-down.

cards.title: COMPONENT REPLACEMENT
cards.body: Main bearings, connecting rod bearings, gaskets, seals, and timing chain components replaced as required.

cards.title: QUALITY CHECKS
cards.body: All major rotating assemblies, oil pump, and cooling system components inspected for long-term reliability.
